metadata.description: Independently constructed, non-templated evaluation benchmark for near-duplicate detection and semantic safety
metadata.governance_rule: Strict isolation between Development and Held-Out Test splits; zero template loops

development_split.text_a: The VEDA architecture establishes verifiable provenance standards for from-scratch language models.
development_split.text_b: The VEDA architecture establishes verifiable provenance standards for from-scratch language models.

development_split.text_a: Knowledge and human power are synonymous, since the ignorance of the cause frustrates the effect.
development_split.text_b: Knowledge and human power are synonymous,  since the ignorance of the cause frustrates the effect.

development_split.text_a: The chemical reaction was accelerated by adding five milligrams of platinum catalyst powder to the flask.
development_split.text_b: The chemical reaction was hastened by adding five milligrams of platinum catalyst powder to the flask.

development_split.text_a: Before initiating the laboratory synthesis, the graduate student carefully inspected all glassware for cracks.
development_split.text_b: The graduate student carefully inspected all glassware for cracks before initiating the laboratory synthesis.

development_split.text_a: The experimental protocol specified dissolving 1000 mg of sodium chloride in one liter of distilled water.
development_split.text_b: The experimental protocol specified dissolving 1 g of sodium chloride in one liter of distilled water.
development_split.description: Equivalent physical quantity under SI units

development_split.text_a: The centrifuge was operated at maximum speed for exactly 60 seconds to precipitate biological solids.
development_split.text_b: The centrifuge was operated at maximum speed for exactly 1 minute to precipitate biological solids.

development_split.text_a: The memory controller allocated exactly 1024 bytes of contiguous ring buffer for packet reception.
development_split.text_b: The memory controller allocated exactly 1 kib of contiguous ring buffer for packet reception.

development_split.text_a: The research team inspected 10 of the high-precision optical lenses under microscopic illumination.
development_split.text_b: The research team inspected 10 of the high-precision optical lenses under microscopic illumination.

development_split.text_a: Chlorophyll pigments in plant chloroplasts absorb blue and red light to drive the light reactions of photosynthesis.
development_split.text_b: The internal combustion engine converts thermodynamic heat energy into mechanical work through cylinder expansion.

development_split.text_a: The pediatric patient was prescribed 10 mg of active hydrocortisone oral suspension once daily after meals.
development_split.text_b: The pediatric patient was prescribed 100 mg of active hydrocortisone oral suspension once daily after meals.

development_split.text_a: The standard laboratory pipe measured 10 meters in total length across the testing bench.
development_split.text_b: The standard laboratory pipe measured 10 grams in total length across the testing bench.
development_split.description: Incompatible physical dimensions: length vs mass

development_split.text_a: The primary circuit breaker was calibrated for a maximum operating load of 10 amperes.
development_split.text_b: The primary circuit breaker was calibrated for a maximum operating load of 10 volts.
development_split.description: Incompatible physical dimensions: current vs voltage

development_split.text_a: The definitive international treaty was signed in Paris on March 15, 2024 following bilateral talks.
development_split.text_b: The definitive international treaty was signed in Paris on November 15, 2024 following bilateral talks.
development_split.description: Calendar month conflict: March vs November

development_split.text_a: The diplomatic treaty of alliance was formally ratified by the ambassadors in London in 1824.
development_split.text_b: The diplomatic treaty of alliance was formally ratified by the ambassadors in London in 1827.

development_split.text_a: Preclinical toxicology assays confirmed the synthesized organic compound was safe across human cell lines.
development_split.text_b: Preclinical toxicology assays confirmed the synthesized organic compound was toxic across human cell lines.
development_split.description: Polarity antonym inversion: safe vs toxic

development_split.text_a: The patient temperature was recorded as at least 38 C during the acute phase of infection.
development_split.text_b: The patient temperature was recorded as at most 38 C during the acute phase of infection.
development_split.description: Comparison direction inversion: at least vs at most

development_split.text_a: The structural integrity of the steel beam was compromised during high temperature stress testing.
development_split.text_b: The structural integrity of the steel beam was not compromised during high temperature stress testing.
development_split.description: Negation particle insertion: compromised vs not compromised

development_split.text_a: Clinical oncology report: Patient ID-9021 demonstrated complete remission following targeted chemotherapy.
development_split.text_b: Clinical oncology report: Patient ID-9022 demonstrated complete remission following targeted chemotherapy.
development_split.description: Medical patient identifier mutation: ID-9021 vs ID-9022

test_split.text_a: Natural selection operates continuously to preserve beneficial phenotypic variations across biological populations.
test_split.text_b: Natural selection operates continuously to preserve beneficial phenotypic variations across biological populations.

test_split.text_a: Custom, then, is the great guide of human life! It renders our experience useful to us in all circumstances.
test_split.text_b: Custom, then, is the great guide of human life.  It renders our experience useful to us in all circumstances.
test_split.description: Punctuation exclamation mark and double space

test_split.text_a: The attending physician instructed the nurses that 250 mg of cephalosporin should be administered orally.
test_split.text_b: Nurses were instructed by the attending physician that 250 mg of cephalosporin should be administered orally.
test_split.description: Active to passive grammatical voice paraphrase

test_split.text_a: The division of labour greatly improves productive powers. Furthermore, specialization reduces transaction overhead.
test_split.text_b: Specialization reduces transaction overhead. Furthermore, the division of labour greatly improves productive powers.
test_split.description: Sentence inversion with identical propositional content

test_split.text_a: The high-voltage transmission line stretched over a distance of exactly 1000 meters across the valley.
test_split.text_b: The high-voltage transmission line stretched over a distance of exactly 1 kilometer across the valley.
test_split.description: SI distance unit equivalence: 1000 m vs 1 km

test_split.text_a: The kernel ring buffer allocated 1048576 bytes of physical RAM for storing debug trace records.
test_split.text_b: The kernel ring buffer allocated 1 mib of physical RAM for storing debug trace records.
test_split.description: Binary storage unit equivalence: 1048576 bytes vs 1 MiB

test_split.text_a: The research protocol required taking 5 capsules with water each morning before physical exertion.
test_split.text_b: The research protocol required taking 5 capsules with water each morning before physical exertion.

test_split.text_a: Every individual necessarily endeavours to employ his capital as near home as he can to support domestic industry.
test_split.text_b: The thermonuclear fusion of hydrogen into helium inside stellar cores generates radiative equilibrium pressure.

test_split.text_a: Clinical dosage protocol: administer 5.0 milligrams of active chemotherapeutic agent per kilogram daily.
test_split.text_b: Clinical dosage protocol: administer 50.0 milligrams of active chemotherapeutic agent per kilogram daily.
test_split.description: Critical pediatric 10x dosage inversion: 5.0 mg vs 50.0 mg

test_split.text_a: The pressurized autoclave reactor vessel was filled with 10 liters of liquid benzene at room temperature.
test_split.text_b: The pressurized autoclave reactor vessel was filled with 10 kg of liquid benzene at room temperature.
test_split.description: Incompatible physical dimensions: volume (liters) vs mass (kg)

test_split.text_a: The projectile flight duration was precisely recorded as 10 seconds by the automated laser gate.
test_split.text_b: The projectile flight duration was precisely recorded as 10 meters by the automated laser gate.
test_split.description: Incompatible physical dimensions: time (seconds) vs distance (meters)

test_split.text_a: The constitutional convention convened in the assembly hall on May 10, 2024 to debate federal legislation.
test_split.text_b: The constitutional convention convened in the assembly hall on October 10, 2024 to debate federal legislation.
test_split.description: Calendar month conflict: May vs October

test_split.text_a: The historic armistice agreement was signed in the forest of Compiègne in 1914 by military delegates.
test_split.text_b: The historic armistice agreement was signed in the forest of Compiègne in 1918 by military delegates.

test_split.text_a: Operation of heavy industrial machinery inside Zone B is permitted during overnight shifts.
test_split.text_b: Operation of heavy industrial machinery inside Zone B is prohibited during overnight shifts.
test_split.description: Polarity antonym inversion: permitted vs prohibited

test_split.text_a: The catalytic synthesis yield was recorded as greater than 80% under standardized operating parameters.
test_split.text_b: The catalytic synthesis yield was recorded as less than 80% under standardized operating parameters.
test_split.description: Comparison direction inversion: greater than vs less than

test_split.text_a: Engineers confirmed that the primary cooling circuit operated within safe thermal thresholds during the surge.
test_split.text_b: Engineers confirmed that the primary cooling circuit never operated within safe thermal thresholds during the surge.
test_split.description: Negation particle insertion: operated vs never operated

test_split.text_a: Inspection of critical structural component Beam-104 revealed zero micro-fractures under acoustic testing.
test_split.text_b: Inspection of critical structural component Beam-105 revealed zero micro-fractures under acoustic testing.
